passed_checks: RP-CL-1: No Blocking Loops or Delays — PASS. Grep for delay()/sleep()/vTaskDelay(): 0 blocking calls found. All timing via timestamp comparison (time_us_64).
RP-CL-2: Zero Dynamic Memory — PASS. Grep for malloc/new/realloc/std::string/std::vector: 0 instances. All buffers are static or stack-allocated.
RP-CL-3: Power of Two Ring Buffer — PASS. RING_BUFFER_CAPACITY=256, compile-time static_assert via preprocessor. All index ops use & RING_BUFFER_MASK (= 255). No modulo operator in hot paths.
RP-CL-4: Volatile or Atomic Indices — PASS. head_ and tail_ are volatile size_t. __dmb() memory barriers added in ring_buffer.cpp and core1_uart_task.cpp for dual-core safety.
RP-CL-5: Robust Packet Scanning — PASS. parse_byte_stream() continues scanning on CRC mismatch and footer mismatch (3 separate 'continue' statements in scan loop).

RP-CL-6: Watchdog Protection & Safe Landing — PASS. HW Watchdog: watchdog_enable(500, 1) in main.cpp. SW Heartbeat: FSM_HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_US=250000 in coprocessor_fsm.h. On timeout → FSM_STATE_SAFE_LANDING → duties zeroed.

RP-CL-7: Recovery Hysteresis — PASS. FSM_RECOVERY_THRESHOLD=5. recovery_count increments per valid packet in SAFE_LANDING. Resets to 0 on entering SAFE_LANDING. Transitions to ACTIVE only when count >= 5.

RP-CL-8: PWM Hardware Duty Limit — PASS. MAX_DUTY_LIMIT=460 in pwm_driver.h. clamp_duty() applied in set_pwm_duty() and ramp_pwm_duty(). Values above 460 are silently clamped, never passed to hardware.
RP-CL-9: Anomaly Jump Filtering — PASS. ANOMALY_DELTA_THRESHOLD=400 in coprocessor_fsm.h. is_plausible() checks abs_delta on all 5 channels. First packet always accepted (no prev baseline).
applied_fixes: RP-9 Dual-Core Partitioning: Created core1_uart_task.h/.cpp. Core 1 runs UART RX + RingBuffer + parsing. Core 0 runs FSM + PWM. Inter-core via lock-free single-slot mailbox with __dmb() barriers.
RP-CL-4 Memory Barriers: Added MEMORY_BARRIER() macro (__dmb on RP2040, no-op on native) to ring_buffer.cpp after all volatile index writes for cross-core visibility.
main.cpp refactored: Removed inline UART RX / RingBuffer / parsing from Core 0 main loop. Now reads from mailbox. Launches Core 1 via multicore_launch_core1().
